assumptions: Data is a synthetic reconstruction informed by public FDA materials, not Fresenius internal records.
The “with agent” track is a deterministic replay. It assumes QA accepts the escalation and holds affected lots that are not yet released.
The agent recommends; people decide. It does not prove the root cause or that the real recall would have been avoided.

cases.name: Fresenius Kabi
cases.title: The famotidine recall, replayed with the agent on the line.
cases.intro: Three lots failed an upstream bioburden check over three months. Each passed its final tests and shipped, and the pattern only surfaced when a customer complaint arrived more than ten months after the first failure. Here is the same year without the agent, and projected with it.
